dedupe_keys.name: de cix traffic statistics aggregate traffic graphs for frankfurt and other de cix exchanges

description: DE-CIX, which runs the Frankfurt internet exchange, one of the largest in the world, and more than 50 other exchanges in Europe, the Americas, Asia, the Middle East and Africa, publishes traffic statistics for each location. For Frankfurt the statistics page shows graphs of the total traffic exchanged over the last two days, month, year and five years, each with the all-time peak, the peak and average in the graph and the current value; other DE-CIX locations such as Munich, Hamburg, Dusseldorf, Madrid, Mumbai, New York, Istanbul and Dubai have equivalent pages next to their lists of connected networks and enabled data centres. DE-CIX notes that gaps or irregularities in the statistics do not imply a service disruption. Coverage: each DE-CIX exchange. Format and access: graph images and figures on the DE-CIX website, free to view; no machine-readable download was found, and the DE-CIX API and portal serve customers. Caveats: aggregate totals only, without per-network or per-route detail; graph images must be digitised for analysis. Simulation uses: daily and long-term load profiles of major exchanges, and evidence of traffic shifts during outages such as the 2018 Frankfurt power incident. Related records: the IX.br traffic statistics and the CAIDA and PCH exchange datasets cover other exchanges, and the DE-CIX Frankfurt power outage case study describes a failure.
